definitions.explanation: A formal way to refer to one's own company, used in business correspondence, press releases, official announcements, and corporate communications.

examples.japanese: {当社|とうしゃ}の{製品|せいひん}をご{利用|りよう}ください。
{当社|とうしゃ}は{来月|らいげつ}から{新|あたら}しいサービスを{開始|かいし}します。
examples.english: Our company will begin a new service starting next month.

examples.japanese: {当社|とうしゃ}では{社員|しゃいん}の{働|はたら}きやすい{環境|かんきょう}づくりに{力|ちから}を{入|い}れております。
examples.english: Our company is committed to creating a comfortable working environment for employees.

notes:
Composed of {当|とう} (this, the relevant) + {社|しゃ} (company). A formal, somewhat stiff way to refer to one's own company. Standard in business writing, corporate websites, and press releases. Not typically used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当社|とうしゃ}の{製品|せいひん}: our company's products
- {当社|とうしゃ}では: at our company
- {当社|とうしゃ}{比|ひ}: compared to our company
- {当社|とうしゃ}{規定|きてい}: our company's regulations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弊社|へいしゃ}: our company (humble) — more humble and polite, used when addressing clients or external parties
- {自社|じしゃ}: one's own company — neutral, often used in compound phrases like {自社|じしゃ}{製品|せいひん} (in-house product)
- {御社|おんしゃ}: your company (honorific) — used to respectfully refer to another person's company in speech
- {貴社|きしゃ}: your company (honorific) — the written equivalent of {御社|おんしゃ}

REGISTER:
Formal business language. In conversation with external parties, {弊社|へいしゃ} is often preferred as a more humble alternative. {当社|とうしゃ} is neutral-formal and common in internal documents and public announcements.
